title: Bassist Jimmy Brown and Suda Renard
summary: Jimmy Brown was Manning's bass violin player who bowed and plucked with no slapping; Suda Renard is a New Orleans musician worth interviewing.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Can you tell us about Jimmy Brown? Jimmy Brown bass violin.
That was Manning's regular bass violin player. Jimmy Brown. Jimmy Brown.
Read music too. What style did he play? Did he use the bow or did he pick?
He used the bow but he didn't move picking. Beautiful picking. Tone. No slapping. Pick it.
He's Andrew Colvin Leonard. He can tell you about it. The more time musician. Oh he came from New Orleans.
He came from New Orleans too.
We ought to maybe interview him.
Let me make a note of him.
